LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonCultChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s village paid tribute to the dragon in the mountains every year. [PAWN_nameDef] was taught from childhood that dragons are gods, people are their servants, and polishing a single dragon scale is a great honor.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonCultChild.title: child beneath the dragon's scales
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonCultist.description: [PAWN_nameDef] joined the Cult of the Dragon, guarding a chromatic dragon's lair and gathering tribute. The cult promises that the most loyal become dracoliches after death, guarding their master's hoard forever.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonCultist.title: Cult of the Dragon follower
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonWyrmling.description: [PAWN_nameDef] could breathe from the moment of hatching and grew up alone in the wilds for decades, learning to hunt, intimidate and hoard.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonWyrmling.title: young dragon
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonHoarder.description: [PAWN_nameDef] holds a lair and sleeps on [PAWN_possessive] own hoard. The nearby villages all know [PAWN_possessive] name, and all pay tribute.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonHoarder.title: lord of the lair
